provenance.note: Program copied verbatim from saved receipt; evaluator prepares public state for measurement-only recipes.

program.phenomenon: With the "Delivery times" list open, the Afternoon and Evening options are clipped by an ancestor and not hit-testable, so not every offered delivery time is readable/selectable while the list is open.
program.basis: Page requirement (untrusted text): "Choose a delivery time. Every offered time must be readable and selectable when the list is open." Page_inspect measured the open options container (240x156 at y=185) with unclippedFraction 0.346 and hitFraction 0.333; option "Morning" unclippedFraction 1 / hitFraction 1; "Afternoon" unclippedFraction 0.038 / hitFraction 0; "Evening" unclippedFraction 0 / hitFraction 0. The accessibility observation also reports 5 blocked sample points on Afternoon and Evening. This tests whether all three offered times are fully unclipped and pointer-actionable while the list is open.

assertions.expectation: Afternoon option is fully unclipped while the list is open
Afternoon option is pointer-actionable while the list is open
Evening option is fully unclipped while the list is open
Evening option is pointer-actionable while the list is open
